Mailing Address

Location

Bartlett, NE 68622
Treasurer Office
Duties of the County Treasurer
Issue Motor Vehicle Titles and Registrations
Issue Driver License’s, CDL’s, School and Learner’s Permits
Collect Real Estate and Personal Property Taxes due to the county
Distribute all revenue collected to various political subdivisions
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
